title: Fluid Yield
tagline: AI yield aggregator on Flare using FTSO and FAssets for quick multi-step DeFi strategies
description: Fluid-Yield is an autonomous, decentralized AI-driven yield aggregator built on the Flare Network. It is designed to help users maximize returns by continuously reallocating assets across yield-generating protocols on Flare. The system uses the Flare Time Series Oracle (FTSO) to access highly decentralized and reliable price data, ensuring that yield strategies adapt to real market conditions. By integrating Flare’s FAssets, Fluid-Yield also enables XRP holders to access DeFi yields through trustless, over-collateralized wrapped assets. This approach creates a bridge for non-smart-contract assets like XRP to earn sustainable on-chain
how_its_made: This project uses FTSO (Flare Time Series Oracle) to get real-time prices for tokens like FLR, USDC, and FXRP. The smart contracts, written in Solidity using Foundry, check these prices before making trades or loans to keep strategies safe. The frontend is built with Next.js and TypeScript, using RainbowKit and Wagmi for wallet connections. The AI strategy generation uses OpenRouter's API to turn user ideas into automated plans. The system stores strategy data with Drizzle ORM and SQLite, and executes strategies through an ERC-4626 Engine that runs multi-step operations using modular connectors for SparkDex and Kinetic protocols.
